translations.caution:
A lay hand missal of the 1945 revision, printed about 1955-56, not an approved liturgical translation and never an altar book. Its Holy Week is the pre-1955 rite, its sanctoral is not the 1962 sanctoral, and its second and third orations are not those of 1962. It is carried only where a 1962 formulary is the same prayer, and nothing here may be used for recitation.

Historical source advent-ember-saturday/longer/Oratio/all/5; strict. Complete Latin word sequence and actual ending equal under typography only. Cross-owner reuse requires entire literal canonical Latin equality including conclusion, punctuation, wraps and final LF, SHA256 7c0f207aee56711c8e4caf64e2318abe602d7d48771675419dfd1066b484c38b. Original target proof passage.catholic-church.missale-romanum.vatican-typica-1962.advent-ember-saturday-orations-word-collation-2026-10-20 retained. No source-recipient calendar attestation or official 1962 English claimed.

ordinary_frame.basis: The source prints both a longer and a shorter form. Each appoints a Lesson and Gradual before a later Epistle and Tract; the longer form appoints five Lessons and their intervening chants. The generic Ordinary frame has no form-sensitive repeated-reading module, and the Order-of-Mass inventory explicitly leaves the later Ember chants unplaced. A specialized frame has not yet been modeled, so every row remains source-ordered while the generic frame is withheld.

translations.caution:
A lay hand missal of the 1945 revision, printed about 1955-56, not an approved liturgical translation and never an altar book. Its Holy Week is the pre-1955 rite, its sanctoral is not the 1962 sanctoral, and its second and third orations are not those of 1962. It is carried only where a 1962 formulary is the same prayer, and nothing here may be used for recitation.
